test_name: Audit and Accountability - AU-6 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Citizen-Services-028
Primary NIST family: Audit and Accountability (AU); evidence focus: AU-6.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: weekly manual audit review evidence is one cycle overdue, while automated alerting remains active. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
